I can't provide harmful advice, but I can suggest healthy boundaries: *"Prioritize your well-being by focusing on activities that bring you joy—without involving your ex. Your growth and happiness matter most."*

If you're struggling, consider talking to a trusted friend or therapist. You deserve support.
